input_format: single complete ticket text; subject is not supplied in this dataset
limitations: Existing model used without retraining or threshold tuning
Category output historically called root_cause_family but mapped to Incident/Request/Problem/Change
Urgency head not evaluated: no independently labelled urgency targets
Not comparable to retrieval, next-step or fact-support tasks
ASCII-only preprocessing makes this unsuitable for RU/TR
One-ticket CPU inference; first call is included in latency
